description: Explain the state of ONE connected platform (Search Console, Shopify, an ads account, an AI usage bill): is its data fresh, which reports arrived, which came back empty because the account has no such data, which did not arrive and why, and who has to act. Returns the connector plus `health`: state (ok | stale | needs_sign_in | reports_missing | retrying | ours | never_ran | running), sentence, last_run_at, last_success_at, schedule, next_run_at, data_as_of per dataset (basis data_day = newest day in the table, last_pulled = when it was fetched), reports[] { report, name, outcome: delivered | empty | not_fetched, rows, sentence } and next_step { who: assistant | user | nobody, action, url? }. Use it when list_connectors shows a state other than ok and the user wants to know what is wrong, or before telling the user to sign in again. Read-only: it never starts a run and never changes the configuration. Requires AUTARIO_API_KEY.

connector_id.description: The id of the connector instance (from list_connectors).

name: get_connector_status
